watchdog_timing.note: Shortened txn_watchdog_ns values are SIMULATION CONFIGURATION so the watchdog can fire inside a discrete-event run. They are not claims that 1 ms draft WDT is shorter than UCIe retry/recovery. In a real system, WDT_TIMEOUT must exceed max latency including retry + retrain (draft WDT-02).

allowed_observations.A: AXI handshakes + response codes (no internal RESP source)
allowed_observations.C: B + standardized status + optional DIAG when exposed

definitions.event_sequence_equal: Same projected event *names* after removing timestamps (time_ns|event → event). Valid for observers that ignore timing.
definitions.timed_equal: Identical full history rows including timestamps. Required for time-observing observers; usually false across independent txs.

timed.note: Full 'time_ns|event' rows; equality requires identical timing.
